what-aiops-is-and-is-not.r: An anomaly detector trained on three quiet weeks flagged everything during a busy sales period. Engineers muted it, and a real fault later went unnoticed.
what-aiops-is-and-is-not.x: AIOps helps with anomaly detection, alert correlation, cause hints and remediation, but only on top of good telemetry and change records. Judge tools by measured noise and time-to-cause improvements, and treat output as checkable hints.

anomaly-detection-on-metrics.r: A detector compared each hour with the one before it, so every Monday rush raised a severe alert. Engineers learned to ignore Mondays, and one Monday a real fault slipped by.
anomaly-detection-on-metrics.x: Start with seasonal baselines rather than static limits or complex models: compare with the same time earlier, require duration, set size floors and review alerts. Add models only if they beat this on past incidents.

alert-correlation-and-noise-reduction.r: A full storage volume made dozens of services fail. The on-call engineer got around two hundred alerts and spent the early minutes reading them rather than looking at the disk.
alert-correlation-and-noise-reduction.x: Correlate with labels, time and dependency graphs so one incident shows a likely source with echoes folded away. Use inhibition with care, expire silences and track alerts per incident as a noise metric.

logs-and-traces-finding-patterns-with-ml.r: A new error appeared at a low rate after a release and sat unseen among millions of lines until customers complained. A report of new message templates would have flagged it within minutes.
logs-and-traces-finding-patterns-with-ml.x: Template clustering, new-message reports, version and host splits, trace comparisons and a change overlay find most causes faster than reading raw logs. Structured, versioned logs make all of it easier.

root-cause-hints-and-incident-assistants.r: An assistant blamed the database for an outage and the team lost twenty minutes there. The real cause was a load balancer configuration change that sat low in the list.
root-cause-hints-and-incident-assistants.x: Rank causes from change timing, dependency relations and anomaly size, show evidence with every hint, restrict language models to summaries and search, and keep people in charge of production actions.

safe-automation-and-auto-remediation.r: A cleanup automation ran with an empty path variable and deleted data other services needed. A dry run and a rule to delete only inside a named directory would have stopped it.
safe-automation-and-auto-remediation.x: Automate small, well-understood, reversible fixes first, wrapped in preconditions, limits, verification, audit logs and a kill switch, and increase autonomy only as evidence of correct decisions accumulates.

debugging-and-investigating-aiops-output.r: An assistant blamed a deploy for slow checkout. An engineer rolled back without checking, but a database lock was the cause. The rollback added ten minutes of disruption.
debugging-and-investigating-aiops-output.x: Check AIOps answers like any guess: ask for evidence, test against data and the timeline, keep a person on every action, and record the misses.
